title: Wake intake decisions when watched Git file modes change
body:
## Summary

`pr_intake.py` watches only object IDs, so changing a watched file from `100644` to `100755` or `120000` leaves an unchanged PR dormant when its contents stay the same. A real `record` → mode-only Git commit → `plan` fixture reports zero actionable entries before this fix and one `reactivated` entry afterward.

Record Git modes alongside the existing `watch_paths` object IDs and compare them in planning. For older records, recover modes from their recorded baseline using literal, path-limited reads grouped by baseline. Existing head/path/dependency/policy/explicit wakes and pending reviews do not require that historical lookup. Otherwise, unavailable required history produces an explicit diagnostic. Planning remains read-only, and the scheduling policy/schema versions are unchanged.

**Compatibility effect:** replaying the existing 626-record cache against a saved 343-open-PR metadata snapshot reactivates 44 otherwise dormant records because their cached watched objects do not match their recorded baselines: 42 share a changed `.gitattributes` object, and two reference evidence files absent from those baselines. The plan reports these as baseline mismatches, not observed mode changes, and does not infer modes from unrelated objects. All other entries retain their previous plan results. No cache records are rewritten and no reviews or scientific replays are executed.

Builds on Douglas R. Colkitt's delta-only intake implementation in [ec1f08b16f85937471950f986fffb2efcb4b223a](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/ec1f08b16f85937471950f986fffb2efcb4b223a), from canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Substantial implementation and review assistance was provided by OpenAI Codex.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B tests/test_pr_intake.py` — 18 tests pass on Python 3.12.14; the same suite passes on Python 3.11.6.
- [x] Actual CLI regressions use temporary Git repositories and `git update-index` to cover same-blob chmod/symlink transitions for new and legacy records, unrelated-change dormancy, missing or inconsistent legacy baselines, existing wake conditions, and byte-for-byte cache preservation. They require no OS symlink privileges.
- [x] Pure `plan()` regressions cover mode comparisons and missing current mode information.
- [x] Read-only compatibility replay uses the pinned current cache and saved open-PR metadata only; it is not scientific validation or a current queue-status claim.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes. No blanket historical suites or contribution workloads were run.

Prepared for roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Hosted CI and maintainer review remain separate.
